reason: The current MultVAE improved macro validation HR@10 from 0.505 to 0.535, especially on CDs_and_Vinyl, but its deduplicated encoder inputs discard temporal information and Electronics declined to 0.355. These results motivate testing recency weighting while retaining the historically successful reconstruction architecture and objective; they do not establish that lost ordering caused the decline. Data preparation, encoder pooling, and training/inference integration must change together to preserve chronology without changing binary reconstruction targets.

plan.data_processing_and_feature_engineering: Replace early history deduplication in Histories with a shared sparse history transformation that assigns occurrence t in a history of length L weight 2**(-(L-1-t)/10), sums weights by item ID, and L2-normalizes the aggregated item weights. Compute ages from the original supplied interaction order before sorting unique IDs, retaining the full history and handling empty histories without division by zero. Preserve one unique ID per observed item so ids and owners continue to define binary reconstruction targets, and extend pack_rows(rows) to append aligned float weights after its existing ids, offsets, owners outputs while updating all consumers. Preserve read_split, load_data, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], supplied splits, preprocessing seed 0, and all four DATASETS routes.
plan.model_design: Modify MultVAE.encode to use the normalized recency weights as EmbeddingBag per_sample_weights, applying the existing input dropout after normalization without renormalizing the dropped weights. This introduces temporal preference information while preserving the sparse collaborative encoder that supported the previous macro and CDs_and_Vinyl gains. Preserve MultVAE and existing method argument names, adding an optional trailing input_weights argument to encode, representation, forward, and predict and passing it consistently through the call chain. Keep hidden=256, latent=64, dropout=0.5, decoder architecture, binary multinomial reconstruction loss, KL formulation and annealing, optimizer, and learning rate unchanged.
plan.training_evaluation: Update train_category, validation_batches, evaluate, and write_predict_script to use the same shared history transformation and pass its aligned weights into MultVAE during training, validation, and generated working/predict.py inference. Preserve function signatures, dataset_name routing, checkpoint config/state_dict structure, deterministic posterior-mean inference, batch size, training-step and epoch limits, patience, runtime limits, and checkpoint selection by validation HR@10 with NDCG@10 breaking ties. Keep training seed 42 and fixed validation sampling seed 42 with 200 users per category and 99 unique negatives, and assess whether the host-reported macro HR@10 exceeds 0.535 while reporting all four category scores, including Electronics against 0.355. Verify repeated-item aggregation, unit L2 normalization before dropout, unchanged binary targets, and validation/predictor score agreement with dropout disabled; retain single-GPU execution, trial-local artifacts, the shared search budget, and no hidden-test access or validation-target training.
